name: Unmei no Kotoba
source:
A voice whispers in your dreams.
Words that can fulfill any desire you may have.
The heroine on the other hand is trouble by androphobia.
They are guided, meet, and fall in love.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ214456.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一道声音在你的梦中低语，
诉说着能够实现你一切欲望的话语。
而另一边，女主角则饱受男性恐惧症的困扰。
两人在命运的指引下相遇，并坠入爱河。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ214456.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
